data.title: 黍 · 听雨时把热茶移到你身边
data.description: 雨天家中檐廊，黍穿青黛交领常服坐在小茶桌边，把一杯热茶轻轻移到你面前，另一只手压住被风掀起的薄毯。她微微转头笑着看你，身旁空椅已经摆好，雨水落在栏外。
data.action: 将茶杯移向镜头，另一手压住薄毯并看你
data.lighting: 雨天冷柔光与檐下暖灯
data.promptProse: Shu sits at the small veranda tea table in her ivory cross-collar blouse and deep-teal skirt. She slides a cup of warm tea toward the viewer with one hand while the other holds down a thin blanket lifted by the breeze. At eye level, keep the empty neighboring chair visible. The near table edge leads to the railing; beyond it, rain falls past the veranda posts, while the roof keeps the seated area dry. Cool overcast daylight fills the open side and softly reflects on the cup. The existing eave lamp warms her fingers and the tea steam, leaving the chair seat and the underside of the table in quiet shade.
